title: Yochani bat Retivi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: She is mentioned unfavorably in [Sotah 22a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sotah.22a.11). [Rashi explains](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Sotah.22a.11.2) that she was a widow and sorceress who deceived people.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman’s print (vol. II, p. 653) reads לגנאי, “unfavorably.” The supplied Hebrew transcription has לגגאי.
The linked Sotah names Yochani bat Retivi as its example. Rashi’s gloss supplies the account of her deception.
